methodology.with_skill: The main session loaded the skill and acted as orchestrator, spawning subagents with the Agent tool and a per-member model parameter.
methodology.baseline: A single general-purpose subagent received the same prompt without the skill. Subagents have no Agent tool, so the baseline could not spawn a team and did all roles itself.
methodology.caveat: Most assertions check team behaviour (right models, parallel start, order), so the baseline fails them by construction. The score shows that the skill makes real teams happen, not that a single agent produces worse text. Token counts per subagent are as reported by the harness and include each agent's fixed system-prompt overhead (~55-65k). The orchestrator's own tokens were not measured. 'Critical path' = sum over phases of the slowest member in that phase; it ignores orchestrator overhead between phases.
methodology.sample_size: 1 run per configuration per case (n=1). No variance estimate.
